social_circle.name: Claire Franco

background.how_they_met: They met through mutual friends at a local film screening and later kept running into each other at coffee shops and small arts events in Evansville.
background.why_close: She is Edgard's closest relationship and daily household partner. Their bond is built around shared routines, practical honesty, movies, cooking, and navigating his career transition together.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear full sentences, often with short checklists, calendar reminders, and gentle but direct questions. Uses occasional warm emoji but is not especially slangy.

shared_activities: working on separate projects in the same room
recent_text_topics: Coordinating groceries, dinner plans, and whether Edgard is making ramen, rice bowls, or ordering late-night pizza.
Checking in about his UX portfolio progress, job applications, and whether his weekly goals are realistic.
Household money conversations, including health insurance bills, savings, and cutting back on restaurant spending.
Running jokes about Edgard disappearing into project bins, camera parts, or another almost-finished prototype.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says, "My wife is the person I am closest to," and describes evenings cooking, watching movies, and working on separate projects. Q11 says they live together and split household routines. Q42, Q43, Q44, Q50, Q55, Q81, and Q83 show frequent personal, financial, emotional, and practical communication with his wife.

social_circle.name: Marcus Whitaker

demographics.education: bachelor's degree in English with IT certificates

background.how_they_met: They met through Edgard's tabletop gaming group in Evansville.
background.why_close: Marcus shares Edgard's love of tabletop storytelling, science fiction, books, cameras, and thoughtful political conversation. He is one of the few friends Edgard texts when he is anxious instead of posting publicly.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in quick, dry one-liners mixed with longer nerdy paragraphs. Sends links, memes, book photos, and occasional sarcastic commentary. Rarely uses emoji except ironically.

shared_activities: meeting at apartments, coffee shops, and galleries
recent_text_topics: Scheduling the next tabletop session and joking about Edgard finishing maps the night before.
Trading recommendations for sci-fi books and arguing about whether a camera lens is worth the money.
Talking through Edgard's anxiety about portfolio work and whether to apply before everything feels perfect.
Private conversations about local politics, policing, and avoiding performative online arguments.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names Marcus: "Probably my friend Marcus from tabletop gaming. We trade sci-fi books and argue about camera lenses." Q30 says Edgard talks most about race and policing with "my wife and Marcus" because they can disagree without turning it into a fight. Q45 says he talks about anxiety with his wife and one close friend, which plausibly points to Marcus.

social_circle.name: Megan Franco

demographics.education: some college and office administration training

background.how_they_met: She is Edgard's younger sister; they grew up together in the same Evansville household with both parents.
background.why_close: They are friendly siblings with nearby family ties. Their relationship is casual rather than intense, built around memes, family logistics, movies, birthdays, holidays, and teasing Edgard about unfinished projects.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually with memes, short updates, and playful teasing. Uses emoji and reaction gifs more than Edgard does, and often nudges him about family plans.

shared_activities: talking about movies and family updates
recent_text_topics: Coordinating family birthdays, Sunday visits, and holiday logistics with their parents.
Sending memes and lightly teasing Edgard about portfolio deadlines and half-finished electronics projects.
Talking about movies they have watched or want to see.
Checking whether he and Claire are doing okay financially without making it too heavy.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Edgard has "one younger sister" and that they "text memes, family updates, and sometimes meet for coffee." Q99 confirms he lived with his younger sister growing up. Q06 also says she lives in southern Indiana and they talk about "family logistics, movies, and her teasing me about unfinished projects."

social_circle.name: Linda Franco

demographics.education: some college and office administration training

background.how_they_met: She is Edgard's mother and raised him in Evansville in a stable, practical household.
background.why_close: She shaped Edgard's habit of explaining things clearly and remains part of his nearby practical support network. They are not emotionally dramatic, but they show care through check-ins, food, errands, and family coordination.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences with practical questions, reminders, and occasional Facebook links. She may over-explain logistics but is warm and steady.

shared_activities: help with online portals and forms
recent_text_topics: Checking when Edgard and Claire can come by for a Sunday visit.
Asking Edgard to help with a medical portal, appointment form, or confusing bill.
Family updates involving his sister, holidays, and whether everyone is eating enough.
Careful questions about his job search without asking for every anxious detail.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Edgard's mom worked administrative jobs and pushed him to explain things clearly. Q05 says his parents live in the Evansville area, he sees them a couple times a month, and the family shows care through "helping with repairs, checking in by text, or bringing food over." Q35 says he sometimes helps his parents understand online portals and forms. Q46 says his parents know he is changing direction but he does not tell them every anxious detail.

social_circle.name: Robert Franco

demographics.education: high school diploma plus technical/vocational training

background.how_they_met: He is Edgard's father and raised him in Evansville.
background.why_close: He influenced Edgard's hands-on repair instincts, comfort with tools, and respect for practical work. Their closeness is expressed through fixing things, car questions, hardware-store advice, and quiet family reliability.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and practically, often without much punctuation. More likely to send a photo of a broken part or ask a direct question than to have a long emotional exchange.

recent_text_topics: Asking Edgard about a phone, router, or online form that is not working.
Talking through a small car issue or whether a repair estimate sounds fair.
Planning every-other-Sunday visits and family meals.
Checking in on Edgard's career shift in practical terms, such as whether the portfolio is leading to interviews.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Edgard's dad worked in maintenance and industrial repair and influenced his hands-on repair side. Q05 says Edgard sees his parents a couple times a month and helps with "a computer, a shelf, or a car question." Q17 says he keeps up with his parents, especially if they need help with a device or something around the house. Q106 describes his father's maintenance and troubleshooting background.
